source: FAO Irrigation and Drainage Paper 56 / FAO crop-water guidance

rice.evidence_grade: FAO general guidance; paddy conditions specified
rice.assumptions: paddy rice; humid climate; little-to-moderate wind; stage-weighted mean
rice.limitation: General crop-water guidance; adjust to local variety, climate, and water management.

maize.assumptions: grain maize; shortest FAO-56 stage schedule

soybean.assumptions: FAO soybean schedule; reference conditions, not Long Xuyen cultivar data
soybean.limitation: General reference values; crop duration and Kc vary with variety, climate, and management.

mung_bean.limitation: One lysimeter study season for cultivar MI-6 in Sri Lanka; use for transparent indicative comparison only, not Long Xuyen pass/fail thresholds.
